column1: # The version a module must declare for a platform library, where it is not the default.
# Columns: library, generation, major, minor, note
#            the Prospero-generation 1.1 registration this row records.
# A loader builds its lookup key from the version the importing module declares and matches it
# against the version the library was registered with. A wrong version does not fail the load:
# every symbol from that library silently goes unresolved.
# The default is 1.1. VideoOut differs by version alone between generations:
# Other split libraries use a different name per generation (`GraphicsDriver` against
# `Graphics5`) and need no row. An Orbis-generation module declaring 1.1 binds the
# Prospero-generation set, which cannot present a frame; a commercial Orbis-generation title
# The rows come from one emulator's registration tables, so only the case with evidence has a
# row and the default stays 1.1. The generation column is the build-flag number (5 Prospero,
# 4 Orbis), not the ABI version byte.
